sources.notes: Ipotesi di accordo 5 July 2024 (Federalberghi, Faita-Federcamping with Confcommercio; Filcams, Fisascat, UILTuCS), CNEL H052. Art. 152 c. 1 (PDF p. 47, printed 42): paga base nazionale conglobata mensile, tranches July 2024 to November 2027. sha256 1f91c11c...
The same ipotesi deposited at the CNEL (idAccordo 194291), sha256 880e20b9... (base64 JSON, sha256 of the decoded PDF).
CCNL Turismo 20 February 2010, the text the renewals amend: art. 145 (indennità di funzione Quadri), art. 158 (scatti triennali).

notes.text: IDENTITY: the salary tables are art. 152 c. 1 of the CCNL Turismo of Federalberghi and Faita-Federcamping (ipotesi 5 July 2024, CNEL H052), the same contract as turismo-federalberghi; FIPE Pubblici Esercizi is a separate CCNL (H05Y), modelled in pubblici-esercizi-fipe-angem. Not modelled: the reduced table of art. 152 c. 2 for hotels of one and two stars and small campsites.
CONGLOBATED MINIMUMS: the base_salary values are the paga base nazionale conglobata mensile of art. 152 c. 1 (contingenza, EDR and the elements of 1976 and 1979 included, c. 5).

IND_FUN ABSORPTION: the indennità di funzione of the Quadri (art. 145, QA 75.00, QB 70.00) is 'assorbibile fino a concorrenza dai trattamenti economici individuali comunque denominati riconosciuti aziendalmente'; the engine pays it in full, as the request carries no individual company pay to absorb it.
TRANCHES: July 2024, June 2025, May 2026, April 2027, November 2027. No prior tranches modelled (lower bound: 2024-07-01).
SENIORITY INCREMENTS: six steps every three years (36 months), from the first day of the month after the triennio (art. 158 CCNL 2010, pp. 140-141). Paid over 14 monthly instalments.

APPRENTICESHIP percentage (2024 renewal): 80% months 1-12, 85% months 13-24, 90% months 25-36 (source: albergoatenericcione.it, confirmed by research on the 2024 renewal). Duration 36 months for grades 2-5 and 6S (track 'professionalizzante_36'), 24 months for grade 6 (track 'professionalizzante_24'); beyond the contractual duration the worker is fully qualified at 100%. Grade 7, grade 1, and Quadri are not destinations. The under-classification (2 levels below / 1 level below) applied to the previous CCNL.
MONTHLY PAYMENTS: 14, the tredicesima of art. 160 (December) and the quattordicesima of art. 161 (paid with the July pay), as replaced by the ipotesi of 5 July 2024.
HOURLY DIVISOR: 172 hours/month (40 h/week × 52/12). Verified by back-calculation: 1458.42 / 172 = 8.478 ≈ 8.48 EUR/h (level 7, November 2027 — matches lexplain hourly table).

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

reviews.scope: Identity, sources, seniority, Quadri allowance and salary tables against the signed ipotesi of 5 July 2024 and the CCNL of 2010.
findings: The 50 salary values equal art. 152 c. 1 of the Federalberghi/Faita ipotesi of 5 July 2024 cell by cell (scan, page image): this file is the same CCNL as turismo-federalberghi, not a FIPE section; FIPE and Federviaggio are not signatories.
The source agreement date 2024-06-05 was FIPE's; now 2024-07-05. Sources moved from lexplain to the signed texts.
Seniority: six steps every 36 months (art. 158), not 48.
Quadri: the indennità di funzione of art. 145 (QA 75, QB 70) was missing; added, absorption not modelled.
The file duplicates turismo-federalberghi; whether to retire it is left to the owner.
